angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 984,416 km at 122.69 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 8.1509 +/- 0.0124 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 122.69 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.415 +/- 0.047 solar radii from Psaridi et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-622 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract): 984,416 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.313 +/- 0.079 solar masses from Psaridi et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-622 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6400 +/- 100 K from Psaridi et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-622 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Psaridi et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-622 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-622.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.255, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-622 (pscomppars): spectral type F6 V, from Psaridi et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 70661: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-622 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.09 dex, from Psaridi et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-622 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.47407, from Psaridi et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-622 (pscomppars): age 0.9 Gyr, from Psaridi et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-622 (pscomppars): rotation period 3.77 d, from Psaridi et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-622 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 19 km/s, from Psaridi et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..39P/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
